title: The ST0056 view-skew gate has passed every tree since doctor grouped its report by class on 2026-09-07
body:
## What happens

`intent/st/ST0056/parity/tools/thread_view_skew_check.sh`, the commit gate's view-skew arm in this repository (dispatched by `bin/.devbin/cmd/precommit`), reports "N generated view(s) match the model" and exits 0 on every tree, including one with a hand-edited generated view.

Its parse reads doctor's text. It finds the summary line for its denominator, then matches each finding with the needle `^residue: <path> -- view-skew -- `. At 9331cb11a (2026-09-07 20:47Z, "fix(doctor): the report groups by class"), doctor began printing a class heading, `residue: view-skew -- 1 finding`, with each finding indented under it as `  <path> -- <detail>`. The needle has matched nothing since. The summary line still parsed, so the script's own guard against a stale needle, a refusal when the denominator cannot be read, never fired: a denominator proves the report was read, not that a finding can be.

## Evidence (dc, 2026-11-19, ST0095 WP-03's red control)

In a worktree at ed3fe6361, with a schema-35 store the dev build (461e39ba145d) made from canon before the edit, the H1 of `intent/st/ST0095/info.md` was edited by hand:
- `intent doctor` (dev) exits 1: "residue: view-skew -- 1 finding", naming `intent/st/ST0095/info.md` ("3461 bytes on disk, 3449 rendered").
- `thread_view_skew_check.sh` on the same tree exits 0: "thread-view-skew: 1184 generated view(s) match the model."

## What it cost

The arm has been vacuous for about ten weeks. On main, the shipped half of the gate masked it: brew's `intent doctor` exits 1 on any view-skew, and the shipped pre-commit refuses on that. What went unseen is the arm's own subject, the views as the tree's own build renders them, and its `--changed` rule, which blocks only on what a commit touches.

## The fix

The script reads `doctor --format json`, as its header ordered once doctor had a machine face: `checked.views` is the denominator, refused when missing or zero, and the view-skew findings are those whose `class` is `view-skew`, each naming its `file`. Brew 3.4.0 and the dev build both have the form, and jq is already a dependency of the ST0056 tools. It lands as its own commit in ST0095 WP-03's unit, before the store guard's commit, and that commit closes this issue (vc, 2026-11-19 10:46Z; hv decision 69).
